formulas.rounding: exact integer addition
formulas.notes: Provider protocol and replication overhead are excluded.

formulas.expression: received=N; processed=N; received_delivery=N; processed_delivery=N*consumers; matches=N*match_share; workflows=matches*workflow_share; commands=matches*command_share; outcomes=matches+workflows+commands
formulas.rounding: each derived event count must be integral; reject otherwise
formulas.notes: The Large processed consumer count is five; Small and Medium use three.

formulas.expression: for each channel and consumer: retries=ceil(deliveries*retry_share), dead_letters=ceil(deliveries*dead_letter_share); for each channel: replay_publishes=ceil(publishes*replay_share), then replay_deliveries=replay_publishes*named_consumer_count
formulas.rounding: ceiling independently per channel-consumer delivery or channel publication
formulas.notes: The synthetic shares are applied once and do not recursively retry retries; replay preserves the channel fan-out.

formulas.rounding: sampled record count is ceiling; bytes are exact
formulas.notes: Bridge terminal failures are zero in the base case and remain a sensitivity.

formulas.expression: AWS/Azure conservative billing bound: one serverless invocation per delivery attempt while the configured trigger may batch up to 10 records; GCP Small/Medium: one Pub/Sub push request per attempt; GCP Large telemetry: 21 one-stream worker instances per telemetry channel plus request-based control forwarding
formulas.rounding: source invocations never batch across channels; provider duration and allocation rounding
formulas.notes: The AWS/Azure cost bound deliberately does not assume full trigger batches, because sparse control channels may not fill them. A source invocation may contain different device keys, but the adapter serializes destination calls per key and never mixes keys in a destination batch. Source is acknowledged only after destination durable acceptance.
